note: The curated tier: places with a reason to care. This is the voice, and it is hand-written. Empty is honest; generated would not be.

items.title: Rim Naam
items.why: Thai, served in a wooden pavilion that sits out over a lily pond in the Oberoi's gardens, under a rain tree — Rim Naam means "by the water". The kitchen is run by Chef Tam, from Isan, and it cooks Thai food properly rather than politely. Lean towards the seafood and the curries. Go for dinner, when the garden is lit and the city has gone quiet around it.
items.source: Our own visit; oberoihotels.com

items.title: Nāvu
items.why: A fine-dining restaurant at Indiqube Symphony on MG Road, open for dinner Tuesday to Sunday. Book a table.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Middle Room
items.why: A listening bar that pays homage to the city's old, intimate music and beer rooms. Book a seat for one of its music nights.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Cameo
items.area: Museum of Art & Photography, Kasturba Road
items.why: The all-day bistro at the Museum of Art & Photography, with a menu that crosses cuisines. Eat here after the galleries.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Knowhere
items.area: Favourite Plaza, Dodda Banaswadi Main Road
items.why: A friendly neighbourhood bar and kitchen on the fifth floor in Banaswadi, open late every day.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Lapis
items.why: The Oberoi's all-day restaurant, with seats beside the water and in the hotel gardens. Sit outside at dinner.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Wabi Sabi
items.why: The Oberoi's Japanese and Asian fine-dining restaurant. Book for dinner.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Byg Brewski Brewing Company
items.area: Sarjapur Main Road, near the Wipro corporate office
items.why: A Byg Brewski brewery with a Viking theme, named after the Norse brewing god Byggvir, brewing its own beer. Go with a group.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap
items.coordsFrom: OpenStreetMap way/370327479 (Wipro Corporate Office, next door; approximate)

items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Maverick & Farmer Coffee
items.why: The café of Maverick & Farmer, a roaster selling microlot coffees across roast levels. Order a pour-over.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Lakeview Milk Bar
items.why: The MG Road ice-cream parlour that has been part of the city since before Independence. Order a sundae.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: La Couronne Patisserie and Cafe
items.why: A patisserie and café in Vasanth Nagar for French-style desserts and drinks. Order a pastry.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Sankey Tank
items.why: A lake from the 1880s with a walking path round it, between Malleshwaram and Sadashivanagar. Walk the loop at sunrise or sunset, when the whole neighbourhood comes out, then go for coffee in Malleshwaram.
items.source: Wikipedia; OpenStreetMap

items.title: Orion Mall
items.why: A big mall at Brigade Gateway, with a lakeside promenade behind it, a multiplex and a long food court. Useful on a rainy afternoon, and for a film. The walk by the lake is the best part.
items.source: Orion Malls; OpenStreetMap

items.title: Neko & Matcha
items.why: A matcha café with resident cats. Order a matcha and let the cats come to you.
items.source: the venue's own website; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Juny's Bakehouse
items.area: 1229, 34th C Cross, 4th T Block East, Jayanagar
items.why: A bakehouse in an old Jayanagar bungalow, with tables out in a green garden under the trees. Order a coffee and the cheesecake, and take your time over them.
items.source: Our own visit; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Bun World
items.why: A Malleswaram Iyengar-style bakery for buns and bread baked fresh through the day. The sandwiches are the thing to order.
items.source: Our own visit; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Surya Book Stall
items.why: A small second-hand bookshop tucked away on Sampige Road, stacked with children's books, novels and much else. Give yourself time to dig, and come out with more than you meant to buy.
items.source: Our own visit; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Liliyum Patisserie
items.area: Lakshmi Layout Main Road, Chikkabegur Gate, Hongasandra
items.why: A patisserie whose cakes look as good as they taste, with one for every kind of occasion. This is where to order the birthday cake.
items.source: Our own visit; address from liliyum.com
items.coordsFrom: approximate — Hongasandra centre (OpenStreetMap); the shop itself is not mapped

items.title: Whitefield Baking Company
items.area: Bengaluru Marriott Hotel Whitefield, 8th Road, EPIP Zone
items.why: The bakery counter at the Whitefield Marriott, with good coffee and a pastry case worth working through. It is the best place in the area for coffee and something sweet.
items.source: Our own visit; address from the hotel
items.coordsFrom: approximate — EPIP Zone centre; the hotel is not mapped in OpenStreetMap

items.title: The Bay at Ecoworld
items.why: The open courtyard at the heart of RMZ Ecoworld, lined with cafés, a bakery and restaurants. It is the place to eat in Bellandur, whether it is a weekday lunch or an evening after work. Arrive hungry and walk the whole row before you choose.
items.source: Our own visit; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Magnolia Bakery
items.why: The New York bakery's branch inside the tech park, serving cupcakes, pies and plenty more from the counter. Take a slice of pie back to your desk, or eat a cupcake out in the courtyard.
items.source: Our own visit; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Nasi and Mee
items.why: The Ecoworld branch of the Southeast Asian kitchen, serving nasi, noodles, ramen and dim sum. A nasi goreng is the safe order for a quick, filling lunch between meetings.
items.source: Our own visit; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Paper & Pie
items.why: A Bengaluru café chain, started in Indiranagar in 2022, built for coffee and for working at the table. The menu mixes Indian comfort food with European and Southeast Asian dishes. Come for a coffee, a pie and an hour of work away from the office.
items.source: Our own visit; brand history from paperandpie.in; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: The Kind Roastery & Brew Room
items.why: The Ecoworld outpost of the vegetarian roastery from 12th Main in Indiranagar. Ask what was roasted most recently and have it as a pour-over.
items.source: Our own visit; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Chianti
items.area: Ground floor, Unit AR 1, The Bay, RMZ Ecoworld
items.why: An Italian restaurant with handmade pasta, at the ground floor of The Bay. It suits a business lunch or an evening that starts quick and runs long. Order the pasta, and ask about the special of the month.
items.source: Our own visit; hours from chiantiristorante.in; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Thyme & Whisk
items.why: A vegetarian restaurant on Sarjapur Road, and the one to suggest when the table is meat-free or mixed. Go for dinner.
items.source: Our own visit; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Anand Sweets
items.why: The Sarjapur Road branch of the Bengaluru sweet shop. Stop here for a box of mithai before visiting someone, or for a snack on the way home.
items.source: Our own visit; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Hoot Craftworks 2.0
items.why: A big open-air brewery on Sarjapur Road that brews its own beer and fills up at weekends. Come with a group on a Friday or Saturday night.
items.source: Our own visit; position from OpenStreetMap

items.title: Gladia Brewery & Kitchen
items.why: A large Roman-themed brewery that brews its own beer on site, from crisp lagers to heavier ales, with a restaurant and an art gallery under the same roof. It suits a big evening out. Order the house beers.
items.source: Our own visit; concept from gladiabrewery.com; position from OpenStreetMap
